node.statement: Let V=Z dot X, so componentwise V_i=sum_j Z_ij dot X_j. The corner-product typing in the H-CB datum sends S_{P,R} dot S_{R,Q} into S_{P,Q}; closure under finite sums therefore gives V in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}. This is a typing statement and uses no associativity of dot.
